purpose: 서비스 운영자만 쓰는 숨은 관리자 화면 시안: 로그인 · 현황 · 라이선스 · 계정 · 스키장 템플릿 · 사용 내역 · 계정 생성 · 삭제 확인. MacBook 브라우저 기준(설계 프레임 1440×810 · 16:9). 포스 · 휴대폰 크기는 고려하지 않는다.

generation.order: wave 1 = A02(셸 기준 화면) + A01(로그인, 셸 없음) → wave 2 = A03~A06(A02를 참조) → wave 3 = 팝업 A07 · A08(A04를 참조)

references.note: job_id가 null이면 이 묶음에서 먼저 만든 화면이다. 제출할 때 results의 job id로 채운다.

screens.title: 관리자 로그인(숨은 진입 화면)
screens.note: 메뉴에 없는 주소 · 로고 5번 누르기 · 단축키로만 열리는 화면. 아이디와 비밀번호만 묻는다.
screens.prompt:
High-fidelity UI design mockup of one screen of the SYSTEM ADMIN CONSOLE of 스키노트, a web service used by Korean ski rental shops. This console is only for the service operator and is opened in a desktop browser on a MacBook. The screen is shown flat and straight-on and fills the whole canvas edge to edge: no laptop, no browser chrome, no hands, no perspective. Design frame 1440×810 px (desktop, mouse and keyboard), so it can be denser than a touch screen but must stay calm and easy to scan.
Visual system: page background #F4F4F2, white cards and tables with 12px radius and a 1px hairline #E3E3E3, near-black text #1A1A1A, gray text #5D5D5D, brand orange #FE4E10 only for the ONE primary button of a screen and for the active menu marker, destructive actions in red #B42318, status always as a small pill with a text label (green #247A3D 사용 중, amber #B45309 만료 임박, red #B42318 정지 or 잠김 or 실패, gray 만료). Pretendard-like Korean sans-serif, simple 2px Lucide-like line icons. Desktop sizes: base text 15px, table text 15px with 48px rows, column headers 13px bold gray, page title 22px bold, key numbers 32px bold, buttons and inputs 40px tall with 15px bold labels. Never use an ellipsis or clipped text; every table column is wide enough for its text.
All UI text is Korean and must be rendered crisp and spelled EXACTLY as written below. No English UI labels, no lorem ipsum, no watermark, no annotations, no extra screens.
Screen: the hidden admin sign-in page. There is NO sidebar and NO header on this screen. The whole background is dark slate #1F2329 with a very subtle darker diagonal line pattern.
Centered: one white card 440px wide with 16px radius and 40px padding. Top of the card: the purple (#5F33E1) 22px bold wordmark 스키노트 with a small red pill "시스템 관리" next to it. Under it the 26px bold title "관리자 로그인" and one 15px gray line "서비스 운영자만 들어올 수 있습니다". Then two labelled inputs 48px tall with 15px bold labels above them: "아이디" (filled with "admin") and "비밀번호" (filled with eight dots, an eye icon at the right end). Then a full-width solid orange button 48px tall "로그인". Under the button a light-gray note box with a small shield icon and two 14px lines: "5회 틀리면 10분 동안 잠깁니다" and "모든 접속은 사용 내역에 기록됩니다".
Under the card, centered, one 14px gray link on the dark background: "매장 화면으로 돌아가기". Nothing else on the screen.

screens.title: 현황(대시보드 · 셸 기준 화면)
screens.note: 사이드바와 헤더의 기준 화면. 라이선스 · 접속 · 오류를 한눈에.
